command: pre-registration: RAA-min, R0 / R2 inputs plus a role channel (Rrel, RAA) against R0, R2, R2l and ReGuide-perc on N1-N6 and K1-K6 (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 73)

metrics.arms: Rrel = pi05_g8v_rrel_ae (R0's frames and whole instructions + channel); RAA = pi05_g8v_raa_ae (R2's frames, role phrases and painted views + channel).  Frozen VLM, action expert, batch 32, 6,000 steps, lr 5e-5, 1,000 warmup, no EMA, one seed, one A40, submitted on overcap (exp main) and tail-lab (exp tl), the first to reach 6,000 exported.  Test: raa.py serve / client; channel from learned masks + depth + calibration (sc_pu.Estimator), pointer from the contact-induced lexicon; R2's views painted from learned masks.  References R0, R2, R2l on dev states from SR 37 / 43 unchanged, rolled anew on the new states; rgp = rg.py client --arm rgp.
metrics.channel: pi05 here has discrete_state_input=False: the state vector is never read, so the channel is a text suffix '<prompt>. rel: +12 -3 +5 cm, role target' (whole cm, base-frame axes, role object until ProprioHeld, target while held), on routed frames only (K1-K6, N1-N6).
metrics.prediction:
RAA-min (SR 73; docs/PLAN_PAPER.md 2b).  Written 2026-11-16, before the training jobs start and before any rollout of Rrel or RAA.  Known when written: SR 34, 37 (R0 .025 and R2 .425 on N1-N6 familiar, dev states 4-23; R2 grasps the right object .975 and places .436 given a right grasp; K1-K6 R0 .85, R2 .758), SR 43 (R2l .417), SR 52, 55, 65 (ReGuide on frozen pi0.5: rgp .929 on N1-N6), SR 70-72.

The test.  One added input, the active role entity's position minus the end effector's, in whole centimetres, with a role id, as a text suffix on the prompt of each routed frame (K1-K6; N1-N6 at test).  Rrel = R0's inputs + the channel.  RAA = R2's inputs (role phrases, the other movable objects painted) + the channel.  Same frames, recipe (frozen VLM, action expert, batch 32, 6,000 steps, lr 5e-5, 1,000 warmup, no EMA) and one seed as R0 and R2.  Test time: the channel comes from learned masks + rendered depth + calibration (sc_pu.Estimator), the pointer from the contact-induced lexicon (role_parse); the server paints R2's views from the learned masks (as R2l).  The prompt carries no other new information.

States: 60 familiar-layout states per task: the 20 dev states R0 / R2 / R2l were read on (harness trials 4-23, read from SR 37 / 43 unchanged) and 40 new states (k = 540-579, harness trials 24-63).  Tasks K1-K6 and N1-N6.  Every arm is read on all 60.

Predictions (N1-N6 familiar, pooled 60 states unless stated).
1. Fit gate: R0 on K1-K6 >= .80 (.85 on the dev states).  I expect it to pass (90%).
2. RAA N1-N6 success about .70 (range .50-.85); R2 about .43 and R2l about .42 on these states; R0 about .03.  RAA grasps the right object about .95 (R2's rate).  RAA's placed-given-right-grasp about .75 against R2's .44.
3. V1 primary (RAA - R2 on N1-N6 success and on placed-given-right-grasp): SUPPORTED 45%, PARTIAL 20%, NOT SUPPORTED 35%.  Point estimate of V1a about +.25 [+.10, +.40].  My doubt: the model must read digits from the frozen VLM's prefix with an action expert trained for 6,000 steps; it may use the role id and ignore the numbers.
4. V2 Rrel - R0: Rrel about .30 on N1-N6; V2a A BEATS B (lower bound > 0) 60%.  Geometry alone is likely to help less than the views: RAA - Rrel (V2c) A BEATS B 55%.
5. V3 RAA - rgp (ReGuide on frozen pi0.5, perception arm; rgp about .90 on these states): RAA NON-INFERIOR (lower bound > -.10) 15%.  RAA does not beat rgp (V3b) 97%.  I expect the policy-internal fix to trail the wrapper that drives the arm itself.
6. K1-K6 cost: K1 (RAA - R2) NON-INFERIOR (lower bound > -.05) 50%; K2 (Rrel - R0) 50%.  The numbers in the prompt are a new nuisance on tasks the model already solves.  RAA's K1-K6 about .75.
7. Channel error at test (smoke and main): median |estimate - simulator| under 1.5 cm on object-role queries before the hold, 2 cm on target-role queries; the estimator's 1 cm rounding adds under 0.5 cm.  The object estimate worsens when the arm hides it (source 'occl' or 'last').
8. Which pairings: cheese pairings (N1-N3) gain more than bottle pairings (N4-N6) over R2 (D1 > D2 in the point estimate) 60%, because R2 places the cheese worse (.52 vs .33 success, grasp equal).  Neither D1 nor D2 carries a verdict.

Labels and margins (experiments/raa_read.py, B = 2000 paired bootstrap over tasks and states, rng 0, as sc_t34).
V1a RAA - R2, success, N1-N6.  A BEATS B iff the lower bound > 0; B BEATS A iff the upper bound < 0; otherwise NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE.
V1b RAA - R2, placed given right grasp (success rate / right-grasp rate), N1-N6, same labels.
V1 primary: SUPPORTED iff V1a and V1b both have lower bound > 0; PARTIAL iff exactly one; NOT SUPPORTED otherwise.
V1l, V1l2: V1a and V1b against R2l (R2 painted from learned masks), reported with the same labels, no weight in V1.
V2a, V2b: Rrel - R0, success and placed given right grasp.  V2c: RAA - Rrel, success.
V3a: RAA - rgp, N1-N6 success: NON-INFERIOR iff the lower bound > -.10; COST iff the upper bound < 0; otherwise NOT SHOWN.  V3b: BEATS iff the lower bound > 0.  V3c: Rrel - rgp, as V3a.
K1: RAA - R2, K1-K6 success; K2: Rrel - R0; K3: RAA - R0; K4: RAA - rgp.  NON-INFERIOR iff the lower bound > -.05; COST iff the upper bound < 0; otherwise NOT SHOWN.
Fit gate: R0 on K1-K6 below .80 reads UNDERFIT and nothing is read as a statement about composition (sc_t34).  RAA's and Rrel's own K1-K6 rates are reported.
Reported with no label: per-task success, right-grasp rate and placed-given-right-grasp for every arm; D1 / D2 (cheese and bottle pairings, RAA - R2); channel error per query.

What would count against the plan's claim.  RAA - R2 with an upper bound under +.10 on both V1a and V1b while RAA's right-grasp rate stays at R2's: then a position channel in the prompt does not close the place gap at matched data, and the place failure is not an addressing failure alone.  Rrel - R0 near 0 and RAA - Rrel near RAA - R2: the views carry what gain there is and the channel adds nothing.
metrics.seen: When this was written: SR 34, 37, 43, 52, 55, 65 and 70-72 were known (see raa_pred.txt).  Predictions, the arms' code, the read and the state builder were committed (ec0cfb77) before any training job and any rollout of Rrel or RAA.  States: job 4757454 drew k 540-579 with experiments/fc_n2_rx.py; the rule reproduced stored k 0, 1, 23, 24, 35, 36, 55, 56, 115, 116, 155, 156, 195, 236, 275, 500 and 539 with max |diff| 0; 40 new states distinct from each other and from 326 stored rows.  Channel build: job 4757434 read each K1-K6 demo's nine slot positions (end effector matches the rendered state to 0; robot base quaternion is the identity), and a smoke conversion (jobs 4757515, 4757516; 2 demos per task) preceded the full conversion.  Smoke rollout (jobs 4757524 for Rrel and 4757525 for RAA), plumbing only: the served checkpoints were R0 and R2 themselves (never trained with the channel), tasks K1 and N1, harness trials 0-3 (smoke states 0-3, not in the 60 read states), output outside results/ (.claude_tmp/pp/raa_smoke).  With R0 + suffix: K1 1 of 4, N1 0 of 4; with R2 + suffix and learned-mask views: K1 2 of 4, N1 2 of 4.  Those successes say nothing about the trained arms.  Channel error against the simulator over 811 queries: object role median 0.83 cm, p90 3.2 cm, max 16.0 cm (the estimator's source: agent mask 547, last unoccluded estimate 255, wrist 9); target role median 0.03 cm, p90 0.43 cm; the lexicon parse equalled the task definition's roles on both tasks.  No code, arm, mapping or prediction changed after the smoke.  The dev-state R0 / R2 / R2l results (SR 37 / 43) were known when the predictions were written.
